name: agent-steps
title: Agent Steps
description: AI agent steps animation: a streaming task log with spinner and checkmarks for agent demos. An agent narrating its own work: the prompt lands in a pill, and under it a log writes itself one line at a time — each step running with a faint spinning globe, then flipping to past tense behind a check while the whole column steps up a row so the live line always sits on the centre.

name: announce-title
title: Announce Title
description: Launch title animation, product announcement intro with kinetic typography. A four-shot launch title: the eyebrow rushes past the camera on a receding type plane and lands on a colour field, the name assembles word by word on paper, and a macro pan across the tagline cuts wide as the line builds itself last word first while a white sweep drains it out of colour.

name: answer-highlight
title: Answer Highlight
description: AI answer highlight animation, ChatGPT-style chat response with a text selection. A question in a pill, an answer that writes itself a word at a time, and then the beat the whole shot is for: a caret lands mid-sentence and a selection band drags across one statement, wrapping the line the way a real one does — and settles onto the single word that matters.

name: answer-stream
title: Answer Stream
description: Streaming AI response animation, from the send button to the answer typing in. The beat after send: a macro shot on the button that cuts — hard, on its fastest frame — to the answer building itself on the page, while the camera pulls back 1.364× about a focal point above the frame to keep up with it.

name: block-wordmark
title: Block Wordmark
description: Logo sting and wordmark animation: blocks build into your brand name. A wordmark builds out of solid blocks — a square scales in, a coloured deck fans out around it and winds back, the stack collapses and stretches into one block per letter, then each block flashes a colour and swaps for its real letterform.

name: bloom-lockup
title: Bloom Lockup
description: Logo reveal in four seconds. A wall of finished work blooms outward from your logo, cuts in tight on it, then bends away through a lens and a flash while the logo rises to take its wordmark and tagline.

name: brand-wheel
title: Brand Wheel
description: Rotating logos text: a lead word and a wheel of brand pills that rolls through the platforms you ship to, blurred rows above and below, then a cursor clicks the last one. Motion measured frame by frame from a recording.

name: button-press
title: Button Press
description: Cursor clicks a button: a cursor walks onto a split action button (label, divider, chevron), it darkens on hover, gives on press, spins while pending and lands on a drawn tick. The deploy, publish or send beat of every launch video.

name: capture-reveal
title: Capture Reveal
description: Screenshot capture animation: a toast counts "Capturing selection…" up to 100% over a browser window, the window drops away and shrinks, the toast pops to "Copied to clipboard." and a two-line headline rises out from behind the window while the cursor glides up. Every curve was measured off a recording frame by frame: the window's drop and shrink share one cubic-bezier, the toast pops on another, the headline rises without scaling or blurring, and type moves by fractions of a pixel.

name: card-rail
title: Card Rail
description: Card carousel animation: cards flicked sideways on a tilted 3D plane. A rail of cards flicked sideways across a tilted plane.

name: caret
title: UI Caret
description: A blinking text caret — a controlled vertical bar, or a pure motion atom that blinks deterministically from useCurrentFrame.

name: channel-thread
title: Channel Thread
description: Slack-style chat animation: team messages arrive with typing dots. A work chat filling itself in, the way the channel actually reads: an avatar, a name in bold, a quiet timestamp and the messages as plain lines under them.

name: check-cycle
title: Check Cycle
description: Rotating words beside a checkbox: a sentence that finishes itself several ways. "Create your own" sits left of a ticked shadcn-style checkbox and the word to its right rolls up out of a slot — Intros, Demos, Launches, Changelogs, Tutorials, And more — then the line steps back a little and rests.

name: click-type
title: Click Type
description: Click to type: a prompt composer (Prompt Send's glass panel, writing surface and round send button) whose placeholder writes itself while a cursor flies in from the edge and clicks the field, then a hard cut into the field where the real prompt types at the caret and send arms. Two shots of one composer under a constant camera, anchored on the first letter, so the type never scales while it moves.

name: count-grid
title: Count Grid
description: Number count-up grid: cards multiply and a counter jumps, the it-scales stat shot. A grid of cards rushes in under a horizontal smear, settles on five and a label, then the camera pulls back a fraction while every empty cell around them fills in from the middle out and the number jumps.

name: cursor-track
title: Cursor Track
description: Cursor click animation: a mouse pointer that moves and clicks over any UI. A synthetic cursor that walks a path of normalized waypoints over any children and pulses a click ring on arrival.

name: cut-lockup
title: Cut Lockup
description: Logo reveal in hard cuts. The logo lands huge on grid paper, steps down in three cuts, pushes in, cuts to night where its construction lines and anchor points draw themselves, then a paper panel wipes up onto the resting lockup.

name: dot-bloom
title: Dot Bloom
description: Halftone dot transition. White dots spark over the outgoing shot while it washes out to cream, then the cream breaks into warm coral, peach and blush dots in drifting diagonal bands that thin out cell by cell until the incoming shot is all that is left.

name: drop-line
title: Drop Line
description: Words cut past one card at a time, then the last word sinks out from under the dot of its own i

name: follower-rush
title: Follower Rush
description: Follower count animation: X/Twitter follower notification with a count-up and avatar wave, for social proof. An X-style follower notification that piles up — avatars stack in and the count explodes, then the row bends into an undulating wave of faces.

name: font-shuffle
title: Font Shuffle
description: Launch title animation: the line decodes out of scrambled glyphs set in the wrong typeface, flashes the accent, settles to ink, then the product name cycles through eleven typefaces (mono, light, humanist, pixel, script, slab, condensed, italic, blackletter, wide, bold grotesk) while the line zooms a step closer on each swap. Every beat is a held state measured off a recording frame by frame — timing, masks, layout, zoom and colour.

name: gather-lockup
title: Gather Lockup
description: Logo reveal in two and a half seconds. A wall of your work sits under a line of type.

name: hello-zoom
title: Hello Zoom
description: Words flicker in place, one line types on, then the camera dives through its own letters into the next card

name: hero-launch
title: Product Hero
description: Product launch hero scene for a SaaS launch video intro. Cinematic product-launch hero — two cards slide into formation as the headline reveals above.

name: input
title: UI Input
description: A text input whose idle/hover/active/typing/invalid state is a pure function of the timeline; the focus ring, border, caret, and value reveal are keyframed presets.

name: karaoke-captions
title: Karaoke Captions
description: Karaoke captions: word-by-word highlighted subtitles synced to speech. A caption line that fills word by word as it is spoken — heavy outlined type that reads on any footage.

name: kuchi-ui
title: kuchi UI Core
description: Shared timeline-fold hook, theme context, and color math for kuchi UI primitives.

name: laptop-frame
title: Laptop Frame
description: MacBook laptop mockup animation that opens and zooms into your screenshot or video. MacBook-style laptop that opens, runs a dynamic-island notch notification, then dives the camera into the screen until an image or video fills the frame.

name: logo-assemble
title: Logo Assemble
description: Logo reveal animation: image cards orbit and collapse into your logo and brand name. A single ring of image cards revolves around a centred title, then spins inward and drains to the middle — giving birth to a simple logo that slides left as the brand name reveals to its right.

name: logo-collapse
title: Logo Collapse
description: Logo reveal intro: a stack of photos flicks through and collapses into your logo. A stack of shots flicked through, collapsing into your mark, and the wordmark landing beside it.

name: logo-drift
title: Logo Drift
description: Logo wall animation: a logo cloud of integrations drifting behind a headline. A field of tiles drifting past a headline while the camera pulls steadily back, so the wall of things-it-works-with keeps arriving from every edge.

name: logo-flicker
title: Logo Flicker
description: Logo reveal intro: a fast image flicker that settles on your logo. Images flip across a central card very fast, the flicker decelerates and fades, and the logo and brand name resolve underneath — a strobe of imagery settling onto the mark.

name: moodboard-reveal
title: Moodboard Reveal
description: Photo gallery reveal: a moodboard fly-through that lands on a hero image. A kinetic headline with a swapping inline image, then a scattered gallery of photos flies in, the camera pushes through it as the background lifts from near-black to off-white, and it lands on a single hero image.

name: orb-swarm
title: Orb Swarm
description: Kinetic typography scene with glass orbs: a sentence told one beat at a time while four orbs burst out of it, split into eight and sixteen, wind into a clockwise vortex, collapse into a knot, pay out as a chain, loop around the closing words and shrink away bead by bead. Every phase was measured frame by frame off a 24fps reference and is replayed on the same clock; the orbs are shaded per pixel into a canvas (a scrolling band texture bowed like latitude lines, a soft glass edge) and the type is drawn into the same canvas four times finer than the frame so its baselines land between pixels.

name: orbit-gallery
title: Orbit Gallery
description: Image gallery intro: photos spiral into the centre around a title. An image-universe hero: a continuous stream of photos flows along an Archimedean spiral (a vortex) from the frame edges into the center — evenly spaced by arc length, shrinking and rotating to follow the coil, with the title held in the clear middle.

name: phone-frame
title: Phone Frame
description: iPhone mockup animation: phone device frame for app screenshots and screen recordings. iPhone-style device frame with a dynamic island and a screen slot — flat or lightly 3D-tilted, with rise, rotate-in, or float entrances and a subtle float loop.

name: phone-stack
title: Phone Stack
description: Stacked phone screens with video. Phone screens rise out of a blur from below one after another, and each new one pushes the stack back: the older screens shrink and step up so only their tops peek out above the newest.

name: portal-intro
title: Portal Intro
description: Sentence-to-picture intro. The lead words fade up one at a time, the line re-sets with a small rounded picture chip inside it and leans in until the chip takes the frame; a title types itself over the picture, lifts away, and the mark and the name arrive.

name: prompt-send
title: Prompt Send
description: AI prompt typing animation: a chat input types a prompt and a cursor clicks send. A composer that unrolls from a hairline, writes a brief into itself while the camera cuts in and rides the caret, then cuts back out to the send button as a pointer arrives and clicks it.

name: prompt-zoom
title: Prompt Zoom
description: AI prompt zoom: an assistant home screen that cuts into the chat input as the prompt types. An assistant landing screen that offers its suggestions, then cuts — hard, in a single frame — into the caret, where the prompt types itself.

name: pulsing-border
title: Pulsing Border
description: AI glow border: a pulsing thinking frame around the screen. Glowing 'AI is working' frame — a soft pulsing border overlay that breathes around the scene edges while a response streams.

name: punch-lines
title: Punch Lines
description: Kinetic typography title cards: bold statements that cut hard between beats. A run of full-frame title cards that cut hard between beats.

name: reel-collage
title: Reel Collage
description: Photo reel that shuts into a collage. A picture cuts through a quick reel between two captions and slowly zooms, then shuts like an eyelid while the captions fold into one stacked line; the copy swaps, the lines split, and a scattered collage blooms in around them on a peach flush.

name: reel-wall
title: Reel Wall
description: Curved video wall for Remotion. A ring of vertical clips turns past in the dark: it eases in from rest on twos, then keeps turning at an even speed.

name: roster-grant
title: Roster Grant
description: Access granted animation: a cursor clicks a CTA and team avatars switch on. Three rows of roster cards stream past a call to action, a pointer walks in and clicks it, and the monograms start turning to the accent one every seven frames — top row, middle, bottom, top, bottom, middle, so it reads as a system granting rather than a list iterating.

name: screen-recording
title: Screen Recording
description: Screen recording zoom: crop and auto-zoom a product demo capture. The treatment that turns a raw screen capture into a shot: crop the browser and OS chrome off each edge as a fraction, fit what is left to the frame, and run a keyframed camera that pushes in on whatever matters at a given frame and holds until the next move.

name: search-typing
title: Search Typing
description: Search bar typing animation for AI search and command palette demos. A search field wider than the shot: two thirds in frame, then it comes forward, types across its left half, pages to its right half, and goes back.

name: sky-lockup
title: Sky Lockup
description: Logo outro in under two seconds. A one-line promise takes itself apart word by word, the white page washes off to a soft sky, and the mark in the middle of the sentence slides over, turns white and picks up your wordmark.

name: spec-sweep
title: Spec Sweep
description: A one-line spec slides in word by word while a highlight runs along it and an icon charges up

name: status-cycle
title: Status Cycle
description: Status badge animation: a pill whose label cycles through states. A centred line whose status pill cycles: the label rolls up behind a hard clip while the pill's width springs past its target and back, and the line re-centres around it.

name: terminal-simulator
title: Terminal Simulator
description: Terminal animation: CLI demo that types commands and prints output. Terminal window with chunked command playback, freeze-frame pauses, step scrolling, and an optional cursor-pinned zoom camera.

name: text-build
title: Text Build
description: Word-by-word text build animation that keeps the line centred. Words enter one at a time while already-placed words physically reflow to stay centered — a growing line on the x axis or a growing stack on the y axis.

name: text-highlight
title: Text Highlight
description: Text highlight animation: marker highlighter, underline, strikethrough and shimmer on a word. Animated emphasis on one span inside a static sentence — marker sweep, color shift, underline, strikethrough-replace, or shimmer.

name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
description: Text reveal animation: word-by-word and letter-by-letter kinetic typography with blur-in, fade, slide, scale and tracking-in presets. One staggered enter/exit text animator: fade, slide, blur, scale, mask and tracking effects over character, word, line or block units, with 14 classic looks as presets.

name: text-rewrite
title: Text Rewrite
description: Text rewrite animation, a typewriter line that deletes and retypes its ending. A line that writes itself a word at a time, comes forward and gets selected — then its opening is swept away by a clip that cuts letters in half as it passes, and a new ending is written on while the line slides to its new centre.

name: text-select
title: Text Select
description: Typewriter with text selection: a line types word by word, then gets highlighted. A line that writes itself a word at a time — each one arriving in the accent and cooling to the foreground a beat later, so exactly one word is ever coloured — then pushes forward to full size on a baseline-pivoted scale and gets selected, the drag sweeping across under a gradient sheen with a hard caret edge.

name: text-swap
title: Text Swap
description: Text swap animation, rotating headline that replaces one line with another. Replaces one line of text with another using exit-then-enter scheduling, with five transition presets: fade-through, crossfade, shared-axis-y, shared-axis-z, and cut.

name: text-swell
title: Text Swell
description: Kinetic typography title with a bouncing letter wave. A title reveal where the lead word floats toward the viewer and hangs there while the sentence assembles around it — each trailing word pushes in and its letters bounce up off the baseline in a wave — before the whole line falls back to size.

name: title-sweep
title: Title Sweep
description: An end title lit by a gradient that travels through the letters, cuts in the dark, and a second title takes over

name: type-morph
title: Type Morph
description: Typewriter effect: a headline types with a blinking caret, then morphs letter by letter. A headline that types itself under a glowing caret, sheds its lead, morphs letter by letter, and ends under a colour flood.

name: word-captions
title: Word Captions
description: TikTok-style captions: animated subtitles with word pop, Hormozi and MrBeast styles for Reels and Shorts. Burned-in captions in the styles big channels actually use — heavy Montserrat, a real outside outline so they read on any footage, and the spoken word springing to an accent.

name: word-flip
title: Word Flip
description: Word flip text rotator: a typewriter headline with a 3D rotating word. A headline types itself out, then one word cycles on a 3D flip — it sinks into an anticipation dip, throws up and away about its baseline under motion blur, and the next word unfurls from below.

name: word-gather
title: Word Gather
description: Word-by-word sentence animation: words fly in out of order and settle into the line. A sentence that arrives one word at a time, out of order, and gathers.

name: word-wheel
title: Word Wheel
description: Rotating words text: a slot machine word wheel that spins and stops on one word. A column of words that spins like a reel and stops on one of them.

name: wordmark-cut
title: Wordmark Cut
description: Wordmark reveal end card: a huge brand name with a hard cut to a close-up. A wordmark twice the width of the frame, cooling from a lit gradient to ink while it settles, and then a hard cut onto its last letters and the dot — 1.71× nearer, with a shallow depth of field the wide shot does not have, which is the only thing that says the second shot is closer rather than just bigger.

name: glass-code-block
title: Glass Code Block
description: A premium frosted-glass code editor window with a regex tokenizer and line-by-line stagger reveal.

name: glass-code-walk
title: Glass Code Walk
description: A camera that scans a glass code block top to bottom as it types, then pulls back to a centered hold.

name: code-morph
title: Code Morph
description: A flat code editor that morphs between versions of a file, gliding each surviving token to its new line and column while removed code dissolves and new code fades in.

name: terminal-session
title: Terminal Simulator
description: Terminal window that types out commands and rolls old lines off the top.

name: terminal-cursor-zoom
title: Terminal Cursor Zoom
description: Camera locked to the typing cursor, dollying across a terminal as a command types at high zoom.

name: gradient-ground
title: Gradient Ground
description: Animated gradient grounds for Remotion: the free gradients.sh engine (WebGL2) with 39 presets, driven by the current frame.

name: achievement-pop
title: Achievement Pop
description: Stacked achievement toasts unlock one by one, the last a rare gradient-filled card.

name: border-beam
title: Border Beam
description: A beam laps the border of a dark card, then reveals 'kuchi 2.0' with a logo and description.

name: card-fan
title: Card Fan
description: Colourful format cards fan out of a stack with a "Your top formats" caption.

name: glow-born-card
title: Glow Born Card
description: A glow condenses into an "Import from repository" dialog beside split headline text.

name: launch-days
title: Launch Days
description: Vertical day tabs expand one into a big card, '03 Templates', under a Launch Week header.

name: pill-morph
title: Pill Morph
description: A logo pill opens into a product card, splits into feature pills and becomes an app tile.

name: rim-draw-card
title: Rim Draw Card
description: A settings card gets its rim drawn in light, revealing a brand-voice toggle and text field.

name: search-reveal
title: Search Reveal
description: Expanding construction circles snap into a search pill, type editable text, and reveal an abstract graphic panel.

name: card-push-line
title: Card Push Line
description: A prompt card with a slash command pushes forward as its text line types.

name: caret-dolly
title: Caret Dolly
description: A prompt box types a request while the camera dollies along the caret.

name: ghost-complete
title: Ghost Complete
description: Grey ghost suggestions autocomplete a sentence, each accepted with a Tab keypress.

name: multi-file-drop
title: Multi File Drop
description: Files drop into a prompt box as chips, then a cursor presses send.

name: query-cascade
title: Query Cascade
description: Search queries rush past until the hero query lands and its answer line resolves.

name: drop-upload
title: Drop Upload
description: A file card drops in and fills an upload bar until a check confirms it.

name: macro-tab-name
title: Macro Tab Name
description: A macro-zoomed tab chip reads "Launch Assets" as a cursor moves in and clicks.

name: animated-line-chart
title: Animated Line Chart
description: Line chart whose SVG path draws on from left to right with a leading dot.

name: animated-bar-chart
title: Animated Bar Chart
description: Bars spring up from the baseline in a staggered cascade.

name: stop-motion
title: Stop Motion Clock
description: Quantized stop-motion clock for Remotion. Stepped frames, stepped springs, deterministic hashing, and per-pose paper jitter.

name: paper-sticker
title: Paper Sticker
description: A taped paper chip that slaps onto the scene over two stop-motion poses, keeping a hand-placed tilt and per-pose wobble.

name: handwrite
title: Handwrite
description: Handwritten text laid down letter by letter on a quantized stop-motion clock, each glyph keeping its own slant and baseline wobble.

name: polaroid
title: Polaroid
description: An instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption for video, images, or live compositions.

name: check-list
title: Check List
description: A handwritten checklist that writes itself out in full, then ticks and strikes through every done item, one at a time.

name: reel
title: Reel
description: A fixed centered card where images stack on the z-axis and each blooms open over the last via a centre-out mask.

name: keycap-press
title: Keycap Press
description: Two 3D keycaps press Cmd and K under the line Everything, one shortcut away.

name: rotary-dial
title: Rotary Dial
description: A knurled dial turns to 10 while its arc heats up and 10x render speed counts up.

name: toggle-on
title: Toggle on
description: A large switch flips on and lights the stage as the Auto-captions label turns On.

name: menu-pick
title: Menu Pick
description: A choose-your-launch menu dims two options and highlights the third on a red bar.

name: ui-callout
title: UI Callout
description: Callout cards route to targets on a product screen with connecting leader lines.

name: toolbar-unfurl
title: Toolbar Unfurl
description: A round tap button unfurls into a tool strip while captions list each tool over a glowing ribbon.

name: url-bar-cta
title: URL Bar CTA
description: A browser window with a landing page where the cursor clicks the Get started button.

name: type-caret
title: UI Caret
description: A blinking text caret — a controlled vertical bar, or a pure motion atom that blinks deterministically from useCurrentFrame.

name: kuchi-kit
title: kuchi UI Core
description: Shared timeline-fold hook, theme context, and color math for kuchi UI primitives.

name: claude-chat
title: Claude Chat
description: Animated Claude chat input — types a prompt character-by-character and the waveform button morphs into a terracotta send button the moment text appears. Warm light/dark themes.

name: chat-gpt
title: ChatGPT
description: Animated ChatGPT composer — types a prompt into the pill input, the blue voice button morphs into a send button, and the suggestion chips fade out. Light/dark themes.

name: v0
title: v0
description: Animated Vercel v0 composer — types a prompt into the dark textarea and the mic button morphs into a send button. Dark/light themes.

name: claude-code
title: Claude Code
description: Animated Claude Code CLI welcome screen — terminal window with a dashed welcome box, recent activity and what's new panels, and a prompt line that types a command with a block cursor. Dark/light themes.

name: opencode
title: OpenCode
description: Animated OpenCode TUI welcome screen — two-tone wordmark, an input box with a blue accent bar that types a query, a model status line, and command hints. Dark/light themes.

name: agent-run
title: Agent Run
description: Animated brand-neutral AI agent run — a Thinking status and short plan, tool calls whose spinners close into checks while a timer counts real seconds, then a markdown answer with citations and a code block that streams in irregular token bursts. Light/dark themes.

name: echo-stack
title: Echo Stack
description: A word focuses in at the center while outline copies of it unfold above and below and keep drifting, like the one clear line on a spinning drum.

name: word-insert
title: Word Insert
description: A sentence edits itself, opening a gap and inserting a new word with a gradient.

name: focus-blur-resolve
title: Focus Blur Resolve
description: A premium focus pull from heavy blur to crisp text, then a soft blur-out exit.

name: word-pullback
title: Word Pullback
description: The camera pulls back from a big word to reveal "The cinematic toolkit for every launch".

name: depth-headline
title: Depth Headline
description: A huge serif headline sits behind a gradient sphere that slides through it for depth.

name: strikethrough-replace
title: Strikethrough Replace
description: Draws a strike line across old text then reveals new text in its place.

name: inline-word-roll
title: Inline Word Roll
description: Roll through words beside a fixed prefix with accelerating timing and smoothly centered width.

name: slot-machine-roll
title: Slot Machine Roll
description: Vertical reel scrolls characters from one value to another.

name: word-stream
title: Word Stream
description: Voiceover-paced phrases that build word by word — the next word looms as a blurred ghost before it resolves, then the phrase cuts away.

name: centered-word-build
title: Centered Word Build
description: Words appear sharply from below while the centered phrase pushes cumulatively closer on every beat, then clears through a soft left-to-right opacity wipe.

name: zoom-words
title: Zoom Words
description: A close-up word reveal: huge words fade into a long line while the camera rides the write head, the line streaming off-frame as the shot eases into focus.

name: rubberband-word
title: Rubberband Word
description: A cursor grabs a word by its last letter, stretches it and snaps it into a new word.

name: kinetic-morph-text
title: Kinetic Morph Text
description: Letters lift, rotate, and softly reshape into editable phrases with sampled outline trails.

name: intelligence-glow
title: Intelligence Glow
description: An AI-style answer types under a question while a soft glow breathes along an underline.

name: lights-out
title: Lights Out
description: Five lights go out and a heavy italic headline slams in, with a blue period.

name: full-bleed-type
title: Full Bleed Type
description: Huge condensed caps words slam in one at a time, the last lit by a sunrise gradient.

name: strobe-words
title: Strobe Words
description: Big words strobe in at a set rhythm over a dark horizon glow, ending on the logo.

name: glass-capsule
title: Glass Capsule
description: A glass capsule slides over the focus word of a two-line headline, magnifying it in italic.

name: version-hero
title: Version Hero
description: A chrome 2.0 version numeral rises inside a glowing ring with Now available beneath.

name: countdown
title: Countdown
description: A monumental countdown numeral inside a ring resolves into a Live lockup.

name: t-minus
title: T Minus
description: A mission clock ticks T-minus with rolling characters, then slams 'LIFTOFF' over a sunrise glow.

name: live-code-compilation
title: Live Code Compilation
description: Split-screen where typed code on the left snaps a live UI preview on the right, HMR-style.

name: grid-montage
title: Grid Montage
description: One shot splits into a 2x2 then a 3x3 montage, cutting on the beat.

name: prompt-to-app
title: Prompt to App
description: A prompt types into a chat and a site preview builds as files are written.

name: file-dropzone
title: File Dropzone
description: Files drop into a knowledge base list and an upload toast confirms.

name: reels-feed
title: Reels Feed
description: A vertical reels feed with a double-tap heart over a launch story frame.

name: phone-scroll
title: Phone Scroll
description: A phone app screen flicks through stops while a headline sits beside it.

name: grid-to-app
title: Grid to App
description: A product grid expands into a store admin app with sidebar and product catalogue.

name: money-send
title: Money Send
description: A phone payment screen confirms Sent to Maya with a receipt.

name: mobile-paywall
title: Mobile Paywall
description: A phone paywall selects a plan and shows a Welcome to Pro confirmation.

name: phone-trio
title: Phone Trio
description: Three phones side by side show a notification, a photo feed and a profile.

name: screenshot-tour
title: Screenshot Tour
description: The camera tours a product screenshot, zooming in on regions of an issue tracker.

name: device-morph
title: Device Morph
description: A design canvas switches a frame between desktop, tablet and phone layouts.

name: ai-image-grid
title: AI Image Grid
description: An AI image generator fills a result with a generated render and Download button.

name: channel-reactions
title: Channel Reactions
description: A team chat channel where a launch message collects emoji reactions and replies.

name: logo-construct
title: Logo Construct
description: A blueprint grid draws the logo construction lines and the wordmark inks in.

name: live-ticker
title: Live Ticker
description: A big comma-separated counter rolls its digits up like a live ticker with a feed above.

name: chart-morph
title: Chart Morph
description: A line chart with an area fill morphs between points up to a 46k value.

name: led-ticker
title: Led Ticker
description: KUCHI IS LIVE scrolls on a retro LED dot-matrix with a gradient on the last word.

name: spec-sheet
title: Spec Sheet
description: A tech spec table with hairline rows reveals values like 4K, 60 fps and 1 command.

name: dot-map
title: Dot Map
description: A dotted world map lights up city by city, ending on 142 countries.

name: world-signups
title: World Signups
description: A dotted world map pings signup locations next to a rolling signup counter and live feed.

name: hex-fill
title: Hex Fill
description: A hexagonal grid fills with gradient cells up to an 86% reading.

name: growth-line
title: Growth Line
description: An exponential growth curve draws through milestones to a 100k endpoint.

name: quadrant-plot
title: Quadrant Plot
description: Competitors scatter on a quadrant plot and the Kuchi marker lands in the best corner.

name: beeswarm
title: Beeswarm
description: Two dot swarms, before and after, settle on an axis showing 3.4 versus 10.6.

name: rolling-number
title: Rolling Number
description: Odometer where every place rolls at its own speed, new places rising into view, settling exactly on the target value.

name: soft-blur-in
title: Soft Blur In
description: Per-character fade-in with a gentle blur and upward motion. Apple's signature hero-title reveal.

name: blur-out-up
title: Blur Out Up
description: Words arrive clean and depart upward with increasing blur for airy exits.

name: github-sponsors
title: GitHub Sponsors
description: Self-drawing Sponsors heart that docks to a header, every sponsor avatar blur-staggering into a grid, then a thank-you headline and a CTA. Single seek-safe timeline, 270 frames at 30fps.

name: upvote-burst
title: Upvote Burst
description: A launch leaderboard climbs and a #1 Product of the Day badge stamps in.

name: number-wheel
title: Number Wheel
description: Mechanical odometer that rolls an integer up or down to its target, direction inferred from the values.

name: github-stars
title: GitHub Stars
description: Inertial fly-through of a repo's stargazers with a synced count-up odometer that locks on the total. Horizontal 16:9 or vertical 9:16.

name: cursor
title: UI Cursor
description: An animated cursor that moves between waypoints, clicks (ripple), and drags. The Cursor renderer is a pure function of a numeric CursorStyle channel; useCursorPath reads the frame and eases the path, ripple, and press phases.

name: x-follow-card
title: X Follow Card
description: Animated X profile follow card — spring bounce-in, staggered blur-in, a synthetic cursor that clicks Follow and flips it to Following. Light/dark, horizontal or vertical.

name: confetti
title: Confetti
description: Deterministic confetti burst for Remotion — seeded particles with gravity, spin, and flutter so every render is identical. Fire it on any frame as a celebratory overlay.

name: x-followers-overview
title: X Followers Overview
description: X follow notifications cycle through as 3D flipping text — '<name> followed you · 7h' — then the total follower count pops in with a confetti burst. Hardcoded sample list (X API ready). Light/dark, horizontal or vertical.

name: logo-enter
title: Logo Enter
description: A stacked group of round brand chips that spring in one-by-one, then hold. Swap the logos to feature any set of marks. Horizontal or vertical stacking.

name: duet-split
title: Duet Split
description: A split screen contrasts a slow grey side with a crisp gradient side: '1 day' versus '$0'.

name: speedrun-timer
title: Speedrun Timer
description: A speedrun split table fills row by row and ends on a gold 'WORLD RECORD' time.

name: story-text
title: Story Text
description: Story-style text types in word by word on rounded gradient highlight bubbles.

name: year-in-review
title: Year in Review
description: A bold story card with 2026 stats is presented with a Share this story button.

name: milestone-roll
title: Milestone Roll
description: A counter races through milestones to a 1,000,000 poster over a gradient ground.

name: rating-laurel
title: Rating Laurel
description: A gold laurel wreath frames a 4.96 rating above scrolling review cards.

name: testimonial-stack
title: Testimonial Stack
description: A social post card with a highlighted line stacks in with other testimonials.

name: waitlist-swarm
title: Waitlist Swarm
description: Cursors and avatar dots swarm to form an R while the waitlist count rolls up.

name: crash-zoom
title: Crash Zoom
description: A calm serif tease crash-zooms into a huge gradient '1 DAY.' with speed lines.

name: hook-punch
title: Hook Punch
description: A two-beat hook stops the scroll, then a gradient payoff lands: 'This video took 1 day.'.

name: pov-setup
title: POV Setup
description: A 'POV:' setup line slides in word by word, then a serif italic punchline lands.

name: release-teaser
title: Release Teaser
description: A 16-second cinematic release teaser with center-out typography, a procedural dimensional mark, moving edge light, and an independent fictional identity.

name: brand-guidelines
title: Brand Guidelines
description: An independent 17.9-second identity film with a geometric mark, sliding palette, kinetic type specimens, and original object photography.

name: typed-split-wipe
title: Typed Split Wipe
description: A centered cursorless type build holds, then exits through opposing fixed-layout glyph wipes that leave the anchor visible longest.

name: workflow-console
title: Workflow Console
description: An independent 46.8-second release automation demo with typed commands, environment diagrams, pipeline metrics, and an original node mark.

name: shader-text-reveal
title: Shader Text Reveal
description: Reveal words through the original OpenShaders hero shader, then settle into white type.

name: launch-anything
title: Product Showcase
description: An independent 26.7-second editorial product film with forest-green accents, original photography, seven editable demos, and geometric marks.

name: fomo-limit-orders
title: Order Flow
description: An independent 18-second trading-interface demo with fictional market data, graphite and amber styling, an original stepped mark, and editable camera choreography.
